svg.title: Rolling-boil water treatment, cooling and protected use
svg.desc: Part two of a Victorian field-water sequence for the ordinary lawful boiling route. A short boundary says that a true immediate threat to human life routes to the Chapter 1 life-first test, which supplies no missing heat or treatment method and does not make untreated water safe. After the source screen passes, use a suitable unsealed heat-safe pot and a heat source that can be operated exactly as instructed. Keep raw-water gear away from clean drinking surfaces, fill below safe limits, keep the pot stable and bring the whole surface to a vigorous rolling boil. Shut down, cool naturally on a stable protected surface, and use promptly or pour into clean closed storage without the openings touching. Boiling addresses most microbial hazards but not salt, algal toxins, chemicals or metals. The ninety-five and eighty percent figures estimate wording, not safety or success.
svg.text: Rolling-boil water treatment — 2 of 2
GERMS ONLY — FIELD HANDLING REVIEW OUTSTANDING
Editorial confidence: 95% rolling-boil rule; 80% handling.
These figures describe wording—not safety or treatment success.
Boiling does not remove salt, algal toxins, chemicals or metals.
Ordinary route: fire rules control. Immediate life threat: Chapter 1.
ORDINARY ROUTE — START ONLY WHEN ALL ARE TRUE
Source card reached “no red flag found”; suitable unsealed pot ready;
lawful heat source safe to operate; stable cooling place ready;
clean cup or clean closed storage ready if serving or storing.
1 CHOOSE AND FILL THE POT
Use an intact unsealed heat-safe cooking pot.
Stay below the pot and stove's safe fill limits.
Keep raw-water gear away from clean cups and storage openings.
2 USE THE HEAT SOURCE EXACTLY AS INSTRUCTED
Keep the pot stable and stay with it.
No improvised windscreen, fuel connection, pot support or shelter.
3 REACH A ROLLING BOIL
The whole surface is continuously disturbed by vigorous bubbling.
4 TURN OFF THE HEAT
Shut down the stove and fuel exactly as instructed.
Move the pot only when its proper handle or tool can be used safely.
5 COOL AND PROTECT
Place level on a stable non-combustible heat-safe surface.
Protect from ash, dirt, splash, insects, dirty hands and animals.
Do not finger-test, hold near the face, or seal a hot vessel.
6 USE OR STORE
When cool enough to handle and drink, use promptly.
For storage, pour into a clean closable drinking-water container.
Do not let openings touch. Close promptly. Return no leftovers.
Container maker must permit the actual water temperature.
ORDINARY ROUTE FAILED?
Treat the water as untreated.
Use 000, PLB or satellite SOS for
a serious shortage. Reduce exertion.
No universal untreated-water rule.
ALL SIX STEPS PASSED?
Use for germ-risk reduction only.
This is not proof the source or batch
is safe from an invisible hazard.
Not for eyes, deep wounds or procedures.
WORKING DRAFT — NOT FIELD-APPROVED
